subtitles.zh: 过去五年，家庭在青少年体育上的支出增长了46%。

subtitles.zh: 我们的资深记者兰德尔·威廉姆斯，他负责体育商业报道，一直在追踪这个故事，现在加入我们。
subtitles.en: Our senior reporter, Randall Williams, he covers business of sports has been following this story and he joins us now.

subtitles.zh: 兰德尔，据估计，这是一个由私募股权资助的超过400亿美元的产业。
subtitles.en: And Randall by some estimates, this is a $40 billion plus industry that is funded by private equity.

subtitles.zh: 所以毫不奇怪，它变得高度竞争和高度专业化。
subtitles.en: And so no surprise then has become hyper competitive and hyper specialized.

subtitles.zh: 是的，当私募股权进入某个领域，他们当然想最大化利润，这对青少年体育来说并不总是好事。
subtitles.en: Yeah, I mean, when private equity gets into something, of course, they want to maximize profit and that's not always a good thing for youth sports.

subtitles.zh: 人们认为青少年体育是大学体育之前的阶段，而大学体育也在欢迎私募股权。但有了NIL和各种机制，
subtitles.en: People think of youth sports as the level before college sports and college sports, of course, is welcoming private equity as well. But with NIO with a bunch of different mechanisms,

subtitles.zh: 它有点像业余水平。我认为青少年体育本不应该是这样，但它正在变成这样，因为你可以更早地识别人才，从而带来品牌合作等许多其他事情。
subtitles.en: we, it's sort of the amateur level. And I think youth sports isn't meant to be that, but it's becoming that because you can identify talent earlier on, which therefore could lead to brand collaborations and so many other things.

subtitles.zh: 所以青少年体育是一个巨大的产业，我们看到私募股权和其他市场参与者正在进入。
subtitles.en: So youth sports is a huge industry that we're seeing private equity get into and other investors as well.

subtitles.zh: 技术是如何加速这一点的？我们谈到私募股权进入，谈到NIL，这是两件不同的事情，但技术让它变得更加激烈。
subtitles.en: How has technology accelerated this? Because we talk about private equity getting in, we talk about NIL, that those are two distinct things, but technology has made it even more hyper intense.
